== Trivia ==
* Greves says, ''"I am the Krytan Law!"'' similar to [[w:Judge Dredd|Judge Dredd's]] line of, ''"I am the law!"'' (in the <span class="plainlinks">[http://www.imdb.com/title/tt0113492/ the film based on the comic with the same name]), itself a cliche spoken by villains in westerns.
